Ranketta is built for teams that own a product catalog and need AI to recommend the individual products in it, not just mention the brand. Online stores You run your own catalog and your own GTINs, and you already feed Google Merchant Center or a marketplace. Ranketta shows which of your SKUs AI recommends, which get skipped, and fixes the product data behind it. Ranketta for Online stores D2C brands You sell your own products directly and the brand is the product. Ranketta tracks how AI describes the brand and every product under it, and keeps both consistent across engines. Ranketta for D2C brands Agencies You report AI visibility for several clients at once. Ranketta gives you multi-client tracking, share of voice and Looker Studio reporting you can put straight into a retainer. Ranketta for agencies Who uses Ranketta Trusted by e-commerce, D2C and agencies Brands that use Ranketta don't watch rankings drift. They fix content, merchandise catalogs, and ship the changes that move them. AI search is becoming a critical channel in e-commerce. With Ranketta, we finally gained real data on how often AI recommends our brand and where we have gaps. The platform helped us identify specific topics and content that improve our visibility in AI answers. Within the first months, we saw clear improvements in both position and share of voice. Jiří Votava CEO 44% AI visibility across tracked answers We'd had an extremely successful two years, and with AI shopping expected in Europe this fall, ignoring AI visibility felt like a risk we couldn't afford. We have detailed BI analytics, but LLMs were never a channel we tracked. We assumed AI answers simply mirrored the market, and Ranketta's data proved otherwise. Today the team uses it as a checkpoint for adapting our content for AI models. My advice to anyone hesitating: unless you want to hire a full-time person just for AI, you should have started yesterday. It is becoming increasingly clear that AI systems are starting to significantly influence how people discover brands, products, and content. In this context, Ranketta is an interesting tool because it provides a type of data that traditional SEO tools are currently unable to deliver. Extra credits €50 / month 50,000 credits monthly Use for merchandising, Agent Mode, and article generation Book a demo Merchandise your catalogue Agent Mode and articles €1 per 1k credits Scale as you grow What is Ranketta? + Ranketta is an AI visibility and merchandising platform for e-commerce and D2C brands. It tracks how often AI assistants — ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot and Amazon Alexa — recommend your individual products, then fixes the catalog data and content behind those answers and connects the feed to the engines that read it. Unlike brand-monitoring trackers, Ranketta measures visibility per SKU, not per brand. What is the best AI visibility tool for e-commerce? + It depends on whether you need brand data or product data. Most AI visibility tools count how often your brand name appears in AI answers. Ranketta is built for stores with their own catalog: it tracks which of your individual products get recommended, why the others get skipped, and fixes the product data behind it. If you sell products, brand-level data will not tell you which SKU to fix. You can compare eight platforms side by side in our e-commerce guide . Is this just for e-commerce, or can any business use it? + Ranketta is built for teams that own a product catalog and need AI to recommend the individual products in it, not just mention the brand. E-commerce stores and D2C brands get SKU-level tracking, catalog enrichment and feed connections. Agencies run several clients from one account with share of voice and Looker Studio reporting. B2B and SaaS companies use Ranketta to see which competitors AI recommends instead of them and what to publish next. How much does Ranketta cost? + Ranketta starts at €79 per month for the Starter plan — 3 AI models, 50 prompts per model, merchandising, 5k credits, one website and one country. Plans run from there to €199 for Growth and €449 for Scale, with Enterprise for custom volume and SLA. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, and extra credit packs start from €10 per month. What is agentic commerce, and how does Ranketta support it? + Agentic commerce is buying done by an AI agent on the shopper's behalf — the agent researches, shortlists and increasingly completes the checkout. Ranketta prepares your catalog for it: structured product data agents can read, feeds connected to ChatGPT, Google Merchant Center and marketplaces, and tracking of which agents actually surface your products. How does Ranketta differ from traditional SEO tools like Semrush or Ahrefs? + Traditional SEO tools track keywords and backlinks. Ranketta tracks which products LLMs recommend, how often, and the sentiment around those mentions. We also help you improve rankings by drafting and publishing the content needed to secure your spot. Does this help my traditional Google search rankings too? + Yes. AI models look for similar signals as Google. Information density and structured data matter, and content we help you create improves visibility across both AI engines and Google. Can you guarantee a recommendation in ChatGPT? + No tool can guarantee a specific AI response because models update constantly. We identify the technical markers and citations engines look for, so following our suggestions gives you the highest chance of being recommended. Do I have control over what gets published? + Always. We identify gaps and draft content, but nothing goes live without your approval. Review, edit, or reject any article before it syncs to your site. Overview CloudTalk operates in a highly competitive B2B SaaS category: cloud calling, call center software, AI voice agents, power dialers, and outbound dialing. The category includes large players such as RingCentral, Aircall, Dialpad, Nextiva, Five9, Talkdesk, and Kixie. Most of them have larger marketing budgets, stronger brand awareness, and a longer history in organic search. That is why AI search became a new opportunity for CloudTalk. In AI-generated answers, budget size is not the only deciding factor. Models work with relevance, content structure, source authority, citations, and how clearly a brand is connected to a specific use case. CloudTalk used Ranketta to understand: where it appeared in AI answers, where competitors were winning, which sources AI models cited, which prompts had the highest commercial potential, and which specific actions could improve AI visibility. In B2B SaaS, buyers are talking to AI before they ever hit our website or talk to sales. That's a new layer of discovery, and for most of us, it's a blind spot. Ranketta gives us a view into it: which competitors get recommended, how CloudTalk gets described, and where our content is falling short. What I value most is the link to action. Ranketta doesn't stop at "are we mentioned?". It tells us what to fix next. That's the difference between an interesting dashboard and a useful one. David Cacík CMO , CloudTalk The Challenge CloudTalk competes with significantly larger brands. The main competitor in the tracked category is RingCentral, a publicly traded company with approximately $300 million yearly marketing budget and global brand awareness. The key question was simple: Can a smaller B2B SaaS brand beat a larger competitor in AI-generated answers? CloudTalk needed to understand: how often AI models recommend CloudTalk, which prompts were won by RingCentral or other competitors, CloudTalk's position across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and AI Overviews, which sources AI models use as citations, and what exactly should be improved to increase visibility. Traditional SEO tools can show keyword rankings, backlinks, and traffic. They do not show whether a brand appears in the actual shortlist when a potential buyer asks AI for software recommendations. Before Ranketta: The Switch from Profound CloudTalk was already tracking AI answers with Profound, an enterprise AEO platform. Profound reports well: real-user prompt-volume data, an automation layer, enterprise credentials. CloudTalk needed more than a report. What decided the switch to Ranketta was monitoring vs. execution: a tracker tells you the score, Ranketta connects it to the next action. It shows which specific pages to update, which prompts to cover, and where citations are missing, then helps generate and optimize the content itself and tracks whether the change moved anything. Commercially relevant topics Measurement focused on AI voice agents, call center software, power dialers, outbound dialers, and business phone systems. The goal was not just to "be visible." This type of statement is easier for a model to understand, compare, and reuse in an answer. 4. Learn how Ranketta helps you track and improve your presence in AI-generated answers. How Ranketta collects data AI responses are not consistent. Ask the same prompt twice and you'll often get a different answer. That's the nature of LLMs. We account for this in two ways: Percentages, not exact counts. We express all metrics as percentages (visibility, share of voice, sentiment score) because they suit the probabilistic nature of LLMs better than fixed numbers. A "25% visibility" is meaningful; a single "yes" or "no" from one query is not. Frequent queries, not single snapshots. We run your prompts across AI platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot very frequently, not just once. The more responses we collect, the more accurate and stable your metrics become. These prompts are conversational questions like "What's the best CRM for marketing agencies under 50 people?" instead of keywords like "CRM software." This matches how people actually talk to AI tools. Unlike traditional analytics tools that rely on APIs, Ranketta uses advanced UI scraping technology to interact with AI models exactly as real users do. This approach provides several key advantages: Authentic user experience: We interact with AI models through their web interfaces, capturing the same responses users see. Real-world accuracy: Our data reflects actual user experiences, not sanitized API responses. Comprehensive coverage: We can access models that don't offer public APIs or have limited API functionality. Our UI scraping technology simulates real user interactions, ensuring the data we collect matches what the average user sees when they use these AI tools. For most AI platforms, this means that they decide which model to use and if they perform a web search or not. This is the reality for a logged-out user and the approach that's closest to the average user's experience. Why we use the web interface, not APIs Many tools pull data from official APIs. The problem: what the API returns often isn't what users see. Providers may serve different answers, different citations, or different formatting through their API than in the actual chat. Your metrics would reflect a backend channel, not the real experience. We use the same interface your customers use: the web. We send prompts through the browser and capture the responses that appear on screen. That means: Same journey as your users. Same input, same output. No separate API pipeline that might behave differently. Works where APIs don't. Some platforms have no public API or heavily restrict it. We still measure them. Not tied to API changes. Providers update or deprecate APIs all the time. Our approach keeps working. Your visibility data comes from real user flows, not from a filtered API feed. FAQ Why can't I get the same answer when I ask ChatGPT myself? AI answers aren't deterministic. The same prompt can return a different response depending on the session, personalization, and whether the model runs a live web search. Ranketta runs each prompt many times from a logged-out, average-user perspective, so instead of one lookup you get a stable percentage that reflects the real spread of answers. Does Ranketta use official APIs from OpenAI, Google, and other providers? No. APIs can return different answers, different citations, and different formatting than the actual chat interface, so measuring through an API wouldn't reflect what your customers actually see. Ranketta scrapes the same web interface real users interact with, capturing the responses as they appear on screen. How often does Ranketta query my prompts? Very frequently, not as a single snapshot. We run your prompts across AI platforms continuously, and the more responses we collect, the more accurate and stable your visibility metrics become. Open Ranketta > What is a Prompt A prompt is a question or query that people ask AI models, the kind of thing your customers type into ChatGPT, Perplexity, or other AI tools when they're looking for recommendations.
